svg.title: Convoy — hand off the big task, get back a proven branch
svg.desc: The Convoy mark and headline beside a run manifest: phases across OpenCode and Claude Code, two measure-and-fix rounds, and a quality score of 92, ready.

g.text: Every step can now run on Claude Code
Convoy carries a big task across many fresh sessions, checkpointed and
resumable, then has independent models score the branch and fix the gaps
